'''Coride''' is a [[Novice]] in the [[White Tower]]. 

== Appearance ==
She has pale hair.

She is a year younger than Egwene, but Egwene thought she was immature, even after a year and a half in the Tower.

== Activities ==
She is comforted by [[Egwene al'Vere]] when she spots a dead person walking through one of the walls.
